items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Oh, Frankie Petit. Yeah, Frankie was here. I come in here. I come in here. It wasn't long. I come right in here when it is. There wasn't over... I was here for a couple of weeks.

ctx.x: He was here then. You weren't here though when Buddy Petit and Frankie Dusen came out, were you?

Oh, Frankie Petit. Yeah, Frankie was here. I come in here. I come in here. It wasn't long. I come right in here when it is. There wasn't over... I was here for a couple of weeks. I used to go see Freddie was over at the Red Onion, Buddy Petit was playing over there. And Frankie was... Ding Johnson. See, Ding Johnson sent from. It was playing. That was right there at 10th and Central.
The Red Onion was 10th and Central. Yeah.
